statements.notes:
Simplified usage
1 Level scoop
Add to your pre- or intra-workout 
Drink 15-30 prior to exercise
Suggested use: 
Consume 1 serving of Creatine ATP daily, preferably before exercise and combined with Condense and/or NOXygen. Make sure you consume plenty of extra water as Creatine draws water into muscles.

Warning: Consult a licensed healthcare practitioner before use.
Discontinue use immediately if you experience any adverse reactions.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if you are currently pregnant, or nursing, have had or have a family history of heart disease, high blood pressure, stroke or any other disease, or using an MAOI, prescription drug, or over-the-counter drug.
Store in a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight.
